project_name: Apex Medical Directory Search & Mobile Revamp

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: Thanks for jumping on Sarah. Our directory currently has over 4,000 healthcare providers, but patients complain that finding specialized practitioners is frustrating. We need a refined search sidebar on member listing pages.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah Jenkins
dialogue.text: Understood. Brilliant Directories has a built-in Sidebar Search Module under Edit Post Types. What specific filters do your patients need?

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: We need filters for Medical Specialty, Insurance Accepted, Languages Spoken, and a legacy Fax Number search because older clinics still use it.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah Jenkins
dialogue.text: Got it. What about the category hierarchy? How are doctors classified right now?

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: We need a clean 3-level taxonomy: Top level is General Field like Surgery, Sub-category is Specialty like Orthopedic Surgery, and Sub-Sub is Sub-specialty like Pediatric Orthopedics.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: Also, more than 60% of our traffic comes from smartphones, but our search result cards look crowded and slow on mobile. We require a responsive mobile-first optimization of the provider cards.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah Jenkins
dialogue.text: Perfect. And regarding timeline, what is your target launch window?

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: We need this live in production by November 15th, 2026, ahead of open enrollment.
